items.title: Global Payments (GPN) Tightens Bylaws While Buyout Talk Keeps Valuation In Focus
items.summary: Global Payments (GPN) has moved to tighten its corporate rulebook. Fresh bylaw amendments now route internal corporate disputes to Georgia’s State-wide Business Court and require shareholders to own at least 1% to pursue derivative suits. Global Payments has been volatile in recent weeks, with buyout speculation and the Worldpay integration helping drive a 25.0% 30 day share price return and a 29.8% gain year to date, even though the 5 year total shareholder return is still down 22.4%.
